review.why: Profiles competitors in three research waves, then delivers battle cards, a pricing landscape and a feature matrix.
review.summary: Short intake, a depth rating, then three waves: profiles and pricing, customer sentiment from reviews and forums, and go-to-market and growth signals. Findings are synthesized into a report, matrix, pricing landscape and one battle card per competitor, then checked by a verification pass. A progress file lets a later session resume.
strengths: Claims are tagged data, estimate, assumption or opinion, and gaps are declared
Checkpoint with the user before synthesis
Honest fallback: without web search it marks everything knowledge-based
cautions: Long run: 15 to 45 minutes with many agents or sequential passes
Wave templates, synthesis and verification rules sit in eight reference files not read here
Written for startup founders; battle cards assume a sales use
